facts.label: Membership and insurance eligibility
facts.text: USAA lists military members, qualifying veterans, and eligible family members among membership categories. Property and casualty insurance has additional eligibility restrictions; membership alone is not a coverage guarantee.

facts.label: Issuing company
facts.text: USAA lists several underwriting companies and says each is financially responsible for its own products. Confirm the company shown on your quote.

facts.label: Coverage options
facts.text: USAA provides an auto coverage guide; confirm the specific protections and limits required by your lender and state.
